admission.justification: An unchecked PATH Node or an unverified archive lets a host run outside the build; test_paseo_node covers digest refusal, foreign-folder refusal, platform refusal, whole placement and XDG resolution, and the downloader's operational byte/time bound is enforced by the production source (MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES, FETCH_SECONDS) rather than by the injected-fake cases.

applicability: Every host acquisition and every process that starts the host: the provision's npm run, PaseoCli calls and the bridge.
conditions: The platform is Linux x86_64 with /proc; the archive URL and SHA-256 come from the contract.
The managed Node lies beside the product's python and paseo folders; the archive cache is under the user's cache folder.
exclusions: A Node already on the machine is never used for the host, whatever its version.
No install outside the product's data and cache folders, no bin link, no PATH, shell or npm-config change.
The Eve application keeps its own separate Node line.
